question_pt: Quando houver dados socioeconômicos, quais municípios tiveram maior taxa de internação por mil habitantes em 2021?
generated_sql:
WITH internacoes_2021 AS (
  SELECT
    i.MUNIC_RES AS municipio_codigo,
    COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes
  FROM main.internacoes i
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.DT_INTER) = 2021
  GROUP BY i.MUNIC_RES
)
SELECT
  m.NO_MUNICIPIO AS municipio,
  m.SG_UF AS uf,
  a.total_internacoes,
  s.QT_POPULACAO,
  ROUND(a.total_internacoes * 1000.0 / NULLIF(s.QT_POPULACAO, 0), 2) AS internacoes_por_mil
FROM internacoes_2021 a
JOIN main.socioeconomico s
  ON a.municipio_codigo = s.CO_MUNICIPIO_6D
 AND s.NU_ANO = 2021
JOIN main.municipios m
  ON s.CO_MUNICIPIO_6D = m.CO_MUNICIPIO_6D
WHERE s.QT_POPULACAO > 0
ORDER BY internacoes_por_mil DESC, m.SG_UF ASC, m.NO_MUNICIPIO ASC
LIMIT 10;
ground_truth_sql: WITH internacoes_2021 AS (SELECT i."MUNIC_RES" AS municipio_codigo, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") = 2021 GROUP BY i."MUNIC_RES") SELECT m."NO_MUNICIPIO" AS municipio, m."SG_UF" AS uf, a.total_internacoes, s."QT_POPULACAO", ROUND(a.total_internacoes * 1000.0 / NULLIF(s."QT_POPULACAO", 0), 2) AS internacoes_por_mil FROM internacoes_2021 a JOIN socioeconomico s ON a.municipio_codigo = s."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" AND s."NU_ANO" = 2021 JOIN municipios m ON s."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" = m."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" WHERE s."QT_POPULACAO" > 0 ORDER BY internacoes_por_mil DESC LIMIT 10

question_pt: Quando houver dados socioeconômicos, como a taxa de internação por mil habitantes em 2021 varia por quintil de PIB per capita?
generated_sql:
WITH mun AS (
  SELECT
    s."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" AS municipio_codigo,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY s."VL_PIB_PERCAPITA") AS quintil_pib,
    s."QT_POPULACAO" AS populacao
  FROM main."socioeconomico" s
  WHERE s."NU_ANO" = 2021
    AND s."VL_PIB_PERCAPITA" IS NOT NULL
    AND s."QT_POPULACAO" > 0
),
adm AS (
  SELECT
    i."MUNIC_RES" AS municipio_codigo,
    COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes
  FROM main."internacoes" i
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") = 2021
  GROUP BY i."MUNIC_RES"
)
SELECT
  mun.quintil_pib,
  COUNT(*) AS municipios,
  SUM(COALESCE(adm.total_internacoes, 0)) AS total_internacoes,
  SUM(mun.populacao) AS populacao,
  ROUND(
    SUM(COALESCE(adm.total_internacoes, 0)) * 1000.0
    / NULLIF(SUM(mun.populacao), 0)
  , 2) AS internacoes_por_mil
FROM mun
LEFT JOIN adm
  ON mun.municipio_codigo = adm.municipio_codigo
GROUP BY mun.quintil_pib
ORDER BY mun.quintil_pib;
ground_truth_sql: WITH mun AS (SELECT s."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D", s."VL_PIB_PERCAPITA", s."QT_POPULACAO", NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY s."VL_PIB_PERCAPITA") AS quintil_pib FROM socioeconomico s WHERE s."NU_ANO" = 2021 AND s."VL_PIB_PERCAPITA" IS NOT NULL AND s."QT_POPULACAO" > 0), adm AS (SELECT "MUNIC_RES" AS municipio_codigo, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") = 2021 GROUP BY "MUNIC_RES") SELECT quintil_pib, COUNT(*) AS municipios, SUM(COALESCE(adm.total_internacoes, 0)) AS total_internacoes, SUM(mun."QT_POPULACAO") AS populacao, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(adm.total_internacoes, 0)) * 1000.0 / NULLIF(SUM(mun."QT_POPULACAO"), 0), 2) AS internacoes_por_mil FROM mun LEFT JOIN adm ON mun."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" = adm.municipio_codigo GROUP BY quintil_pib ORDER BY quintil_pib

question_pt: Quando houver dados socioeconômicos, como a taxa de mortalidade hospitalar em 2021 varia por quintil de leitos SUS por mil habitantes?
generated_sql:
WITH mun AS (
  SELECT
    s."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" AS municipio_codigo,
    s."VL_LEITOS_SUS_1000" AS vl_leitos_sus_1000,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY s."VL_LEITOS_SUS_1000") AS quintil_leitos
  FROM main."socioeconomico" s
  WHERE s."NU_ANO" = 2021
    AND s."VL_LEITOS_SUS_1000" IS NOT NULL
),
adm AS (
  SELECT
    i."MUNIC_RES" AS municipio_codigo,
    COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i."MORTE" = true) AS total_mortes
  FROM main."internacoes" i
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") = 2021
  GROUP BY i."MUNIC_RES"
)
SELECT
  mun.quintil_leitos,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mun.municipio_codigo) AS municipios,
  SUM(COALESCE(adm.total_internacoes, 0)) AS total_internacoes,
  SUM(COALESCE(adm.total_mortes, 0)) AS total_mortes,
  ROUND(
    SUM(COALESCE(adm.total_mortes, 0)) * 100.0
    / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(adm.total_internacoes, 0)), 0)
  , 2) AS taxa_mortalidade_hospitalar
FROM mun
LEFT JOIN adm
  ON mun.municipio_codigo = adm.municipio_codigo
GROUP BY mun.quintil_leitos
ORDER BY mun.quintil_leitos;
ground_truth_sql: WITH mun AS (SELECT s."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D", s."VL_LEITOS_SUS_1000", NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY s."VL_LEITOS_SUS_1000") AS quintil_leitos FROM socioeconomico s WHERE s."NU_ANO" = 2021 AND s."VL_LEITOS_SUS_1000" IS NOT NULL), adm AS (SELECT "MUNIC_RES" AS municipio_codigo, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN "MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mortes FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") = 2021 GROUP BY "MUNIC_RES") SELECT quintil_leitos, COUNT(*) AS municipios, SUM(COALESCE(adm.total_internacoes, 0)) AS total_internacoes, SUM(COALESCE(adm.total_mortes, 0)) AS total_mortes, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(adm.total_mortes, 0)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(adm.total_internacoes, 0)), 0), 2) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM mun LEFT JOIN adm ON mun."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" = adm.municipio_codigo GROUP BY quintil_leitos ORDER BY quintil_leitos
